verdict.rationale: Adyen's own docs say POS payments can continue during a temporary loss of internet connectivity once offline payments are enabled, and its marketing says terminals stay running when the internet is down. The evidence never describes how offline transactions are stored and forwarded or settled when connectivity returns. missing for 10: documentation of the store-and-forward and sync-on-reconnect mechanism, offline limits/risk controls (e.g. floor limits, transaction caps), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can keep taking card payments when the internet drops, with transactions stored and forwarded when connectivity returns

citations.quote: When there is a temporary loss of internet connectivity, you can continue making point-of-sale payments if offline payments have been enabled.
They stay up and running, even when the internet is down.
